fields.description: Issue of MIAMI LIFE (Vol. 9, No. 3) dated October 6, 1934. Prominent editorial content discusses Miami housing and rent conditions ("Landlords nosing out Miami Shylocks") and the impact of high rents on the city’s tourist economy. Includes a nationally sourced political column excerpt about the Roosevelt administration and Louis McHenry Howe, along with local commentary and gossip-style columns. Contains extensive radio program schedules and a substantial horse-racing tipster feature/advertising content ("Jockey Jimmy"), plus local advertisements and notices.
